summary: All 3 blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json.

items.title: Official default source is not materializable after bundled deletion
items.rationale: R3 requires automatic official provider completion but does not define the materializable source after bundled deletion.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R3] and clarifications omit official source id/type/remote and test materialization rules.

items.title: Legacy preset migration omits manifestless override semantics
items.rationale: R4 removes `.senti/presets/<key>` runtime override but does not define upgrade behavior for directories without `preset.json`.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R4] only says migrate or fail; it does not distinguish manifestless same-key override, manifestless bare preset, and explicit manifest cases.

items.title: Locale and AGENTS chain resolution lacks deterministic semantics
items.rationale: R5 includes locale and AGENTS paths, but acceptance coverage only names `@presets` include behavior.
items.evidence: spec.json R5, AC-5, and T-3 do not state parent-chain order, multi-type order, or precedence for locale and AGENTS template resolution.
